app_metadata.name: Mooziac
app_metadata.description: Native macOS music player uniting YouTube Music and high-fidelity local audio with trackpad gestures and notch lyrics.

audio_route_monitoring.action: Pauses playback when headphones or AirPods disconnect

volume_modes.system_sound: Controls macOS CoreAudio Master Device Output
volume_modes.focus_audio: Controls WebKit / AVPlayer internal gain independently without changing macOS master volume

corner_tap_gestures.detection_zone: Corners within 2.5mm or normalized x <= 0.005 / x >= 0.995, y <= 0.15

keyboard_shortcuts.Cmd+W: Close Window (continues playing in menu bar)

multi_tier_fallback.source: Local .lrc sidecar file in audio track directory or ~/Music/Mooziac/
YouTube Music InnerTube synchronized lyrics payload
LRCLib API exact track duration match
LRCLib API query search by title and artist

centered_hud.docking: Centered directly below MacBook display notch or menu bar
centered_hud.window_style: Floating borderless NSPanel with transparent background
centered_hud.highlighting: Current line highlighted with smooth alpha fade for past lines
centered_hud.user_adjustments: Timestamp offset slider (+/- 0.5s increments via Cmd+[ and Cmd+])

sidebar_drawer.view: Full scrollable lyrics panel within main player window

youtube_music_streaming.engine: WebKit WKWebView with isolated data store
youtube_music_streaming.custom_user_agent: Desktop Safari modern User-Agent for Google account login compatibility
youtube_music_streaming.features: Ad-free experience, account sync, library browsing, liked songs, personal playlists

offline_downloads.helper_binary: yt-dlp standalone binary managed by internal DependencyManager
offline_downloads.metadata_embedding: Automatic embedding of track title, artist, album, and high-res thumbnail cover art
offline_downloads.failure_recovery: In-app retry button with automatic yt-dlp binary update check

themes.name: OLED Dark Mode
themes.description: True #000000 black background with high-contrast accents, optimized for Liquid Retina XDR and OLED displays

themes.name: Adaptive Ambient Glow
themes.description: Extracts dominant and secondary color palettes from current album artwork to render dynamic ambient backdrops

themes.name: Pure Crystal Glass
themes.description: Translucent glass effect with a subtle 1.2px #B3B8B5 rim stroke border

themes.name: Watery Pure Transparent
themes.description: High-transparency vibrant blur showcasing desktop wallpaper

progress_bars.name: Neon Glow
progress_bars.description: Glowing liquid capsule scrubber with dynamic color shadow

progress_bars.name: Cyber Dots
progress_bars.description: Retro pulsing LED dot matrix display

progress_bars.name: Minimal Line
progress_bars.description: Zero-overhead 2px precision scrub line for maximum battery savings

menu_bar_integration.status_item: NSStatusItem with mini playback controls and marquee track title
menu_bar_integration.menu_bar_only_mode: Allows running strictly as an accessory app without a Dock icon

discord_rich_presence.details_shown: Song title, artist name, album art, elapsed/remaining time

macos_now_playing.center: MPNowPlayingInfoCenter integration for Control Center and Lock Screen widgets
macos_now_playing.remote_commands: MPRemoteCommandCenter for hardware and Bluetooth media keys

privacy.telemetry: Zero analytics SDKs, zero telemetry endpoints
